summary: NextEra Energy (NEE) files an 8-K to incorporate financial statements of Dominion Energy into its registration statements in connection with the pending acquisition announced May 15, 2026. The deal structure involves two sequential mergers: first, Merger Sub Corp merges into Dominion, making Dominion a wholly owned NEE subsidiary; second, the surviving corporation merges into LLC Sub, also a wholly owned NEE subsidiary. The filing does not disclose price per share, premium, or break fee. The transaction is subject to regulatory approval from the Virginia State Corporation Commission and other customary conditions. Watch for the regulatory timeline and any competing bids or antitrust scrutiny that may affect the risk-arb spread.
